operations: "mutation UpdateDeviceInstalledApps($deviceId: ID!, $apps: [InstalledAppInput!]!) { updateDeviceInstalledApps(deviceId: $deviceId, apps: $apps) { success message error } }"
"mutation TriggerAppUsageSync($deviceId: ID!) { triggerAppUsageSync(deviceId: $deviceId) { success message error } }"
"mutation TriggerPermissionSyncMutation($deviceId: ID!) { triggerPermissionSync(deviceId: $deviceId) { success message error } }"

"mutation AddRestrictionMutation($deviceIds: [ID!]!, $featureId: String, $isEnable: Boolean, $metadata: [NameValueInput!], $restrictedItems: [RestrictedItemInput!]) { addRestriction(deviceIds: $deviceIds, featureId: $featureId, isEnable: $isEnable, metadata: $metadata, restrictedItems: $restrictedItems) { deviceId success code error restriction { id featureId isEnable rev metadata { name value } restrictedItems { id type value blockingMode startTimestamp duration schedules { name startTime endTime daysOfWeek isEnabled } metadata { name value } } } } }"
"mutation AcceptSupervision($whom: ID!, $relationshipType: RelationshipType) { acceptSupervision(whom: $whom, relationshipType: $relationshipType) { id type status whom { id name email } } }"

"query GetChildDevicesWithPermissionsQuery { me { id name relationships { id type status whom { id name email isSupervised devices { id uniqueDeviceId deviceName deviceType metadata { name value } permissionStatus { deviceId uniqueDeviceId permissions { type status isRequired description } lastUpdated } } } } } }"

"mutation UpdateFirebaseTokenMutation($uniqueDeviceId: String!, $firebaseToken: String!) { updateFirebaseToken(uniqueDeviceId: $uniqueDeviceId, firebaseToken: $firebaseToken) { id deviceName uniqueDeviceId } }"
"mutation DeviceCheckInMutation($uniqueDeviceId: String!) { deviceCheckIn(uniqueDeviceId: $uniqueDeviceId) { restrictionsRev } }"

"query GetDeviceRestrictionsQuery($deviceId: ID!, $offset: Int, $limit: Int) { device(id: $deviceId) { id deviceName restrictions(offset: $offset, limit: $limit) { id featureId isEnable rev metadata { name value } restrictedItems { id type value blockingMode startTimestamp duration schedules { name startTime endTime daysOfWeek isEnabled } metadata { name value } } } } }"

"mutation RemoveRestrictionMutation($deviceIds: [ID!]!, $restrictionId: ID, $featureId: String, $ifRev: Int) { removeRestriction(deviceIds: $deviceIds, restrictionId: $restrictionId, featureId: $featureId, ifRev: $ifRev) { deviceId success code error } }"
"mutation DeleteDeviceMutation($id: ID!) { deleteDevice(id: $id) }"

"mutation RequestSupervisionByEmail($email: String!, $relationshipType: RelationshipType) { requestSupervisionByEmail(email: $email, relationshipType: $relationshipType) { id type status from { id } whom { id name email } } }"

"mutation CreateDeviceMutation($deviceType: DeviceType!, $deviceName: String!, $uniqueDeviceId: String!, $firebaseToken: String, $deviceKey: String) { createDevice(deviceType: $deviceType, deviceName: $deviceName, uniqueDeviceId: $uniqueDeviceId, firebaseToken: $firebaseToken, deviceKey: $deviceKey) { id deviceName uniqueDeviceId metadata { name value } } }"
"query SupervisionRequests { me { id relationships { id type status whom { id name email phone } from { id name email phone } } } }"
"mutation UpdateDeviceMetadataMutation($id: ID!, $metadata: [NameValueInput!]) { updateDevice(id: $id, metadata: $metadata) { id deviceName uniqueDeviceId metadata { name value } } }"
"query attribute must be set in fallback element"
"mutation CancelSupervision($whom: ID!, $relationshipType: RelationshipType) { cancelSupervision(whom: $whom, relationshipType: $relationshipType) { id type status whom { id name email } } }"

"query GetReferralDataQuery($productId: String) { me { referral(productId: $productId) { code link commissionRate totalPurchases totalRegistrations totalEarnings availableBalance totalWithdrawn status } } }"

"query MyDeviceAlertsQuery($state: DeviceAlertState, $offset: Int, $limit: Int) { myDeviceAlerts(state: $state, offset: $offset, limit: $limit) { items { id deviceId deviceName personName type severity state openedAt resolvedAt context { permissions packages lastSeenAt thresholdHours } read } total unreadCount } }"
"mutation RejectSupervision($whom: ID!, $relationshipType: RelationshipType) { rejectSupervision(whom: $whom, relationshipType: $relationshipType) { id type status whom { id name email } } }"

"query GetChildDevicesQuery { me { id name relationships { id type status whom { id name email isSupervised isChild devices { id uniqueDeviceId deviceName deviceType metadata { name value } dnsSettings { dnsUrl lastSyncTime } installedApps { packageName appName isSystemApp } lastInstalledAppsSync } } } } }"
"mutation UpdateDeviceAppUsage($deviceId: ID!, $entries: [AppUsageEntryInput!]!) { updateDeviceAppUsage(deviceId: $deviceId, entries: $entries) { success message error } }"

"mutation CreateGoogleSubscription($productCode: String!, $purchaseToken: String!) { createGoogleSubscription(productCode: $productCode, purchaseToken: $purchaseToken) { id name type status recurring serverDateTime currentPeriodStart currentPeriodEnd provider providerPlanId providerSubscriptionId amount currency metadata { name value } } }"

"mutation OrgDeviceCheckInMutation($uniqueDeviceId: String!, $client: OrgDeviceClientInput, $phoneKey: String) { orgDeviceCheckIn(uniqueDeviceId: $uniqueDeviceId, client: $client, phoneKey: $phoneKey) { restrictionsRev } }"
"mutation TriggerDnsSyncMutation($deviceId: ID!) { triggerDnsSync(deviceId: $deviceId) { success message error } }"

"mutation UpdateDevicePermissionStatusMutation($deviceId: ID, $uniqueDeviceId: String, $permissions: [PermissionInfoInput!]!) { updateDevicePermissionStatus(deviceId: $deviceId, uniqueDeviceId: $uniqueDeviceId, permissions: $permissions) { success error permissionStatus { deviceId uniqueDeviceId permissions { type status isRequired description } lastUpdated } } }"
"query GetChildDeviceAppUsage($deviceId: ID!) { device(id: $deviceId) { id deviceName appUsageData { packageName appName date hour duration } lastAppUsageSync } }"
"mutation MarkDeviceAlertsReadMutation($ids: [ID!]!) { markDeviceAlertsRead(ids: $ids) }"

"query GetDevicePermissionStatusQuery($deviceId: ID!) { device(id: $deviceId) { id uniqueDeviceId deviceName deviceType permissionStatus { deviceId uniqueDeviceId permissions { type status isRequired description } lastUpdated } } }"

"mutation UpdateRestrictionMutation($deviceIds: [ID!]!, $id: ID, $featureId: String, $isEnable: Boolean, $metadata: [NameValueInput!], $restrictedItems: [RestrictedItemInput!], $ifRev: Int) { updateRestriction(deviceIds: $deviceIds, id: $id, featureId: $featureId, isEnable: $isEnable, metadata: $metadata, restrictedItems: $restrictedItems, ifRev: $ifRev) { deviceId success code error restriction { id featureId isEnable rev metadata { name value } restrictedItems { id type value blockingMode startTimestamp duration schedules { name startTime endTime daysOfWeek isEnabled } metadata { name value } } } } }"
"mutation UpdateDeviceDnsSettingsMutation($deviceId: ID!, $dnsUrl: String!) { updateDeviceDnsSettings(deviceId: $deviceId, dnsUrl: $dnsUrl) { success dnsSettings { dnsUrl lastSyncTime } error } }"
"mutation TriggerInstalledAppsSync($deviceId: ID!) { triggerInstalledAppsSync(deviceId: $deviceId) { success message error } }"

"query GetMeQuery { me { id name email phone picture status isSupervised hasParent hasAccountabilityPartner isChild devices(limit: 1000) { id uniqueDeviceId deviceName metadata { name value } } relationships(limit: 1000) { type status whom { name email } } subscriptions(limit: 1000) { id name status type recurring cancelAtPeriodEnd providerPlanId isGiftSent currentPeriodStart currentPeriodEnd serverDateTime metadata { name value } eligibleClients } } }"
"mutation UpdateDeviceSiteVisits($deviceId: ID!, $days: [SiteVisitDayInput!]!) { updateDeviceSiteVisits(deviceId: $deviceId, days: $days) { success message error } }"

"query GetChildDeviceSiteVisits($deviceId: ID!, $from: String!, $to: String!, $limit: Int) { deviceSiteVisits(deviceId: $deviceId, from: $from, to: $to, limit: $limit) { topSites { domain visits blocked activeSeconds } } }"
